items.title: NetApp (NTAP) Stock Looks Near Fair Value While Earnings Trade At A Premium
items.summary: After a strong multi year run, NetApp now trades at a level where the share price and the intrinsic value estimate tell a similar story. At the same time, the broader valuation checks still suggest the stock is not an obvious bargain. NetApp has returned 176.2% over the past 5 years, which puts extra focus on whether current expectations are already fully reflected in the share price. The recent acquisition of JetStream Software can support growth in cyber resilience and data protection...

items.title: 2 Services Stocks on Our Watchlist and 1 We Brush Off
items.summary: Business services providers play a critical role for enterprises, assisting them with everything from new hardware integrations to consulting and marketing. These firms have helped their customers unlock huge efficiencies, so it’s no surprise the industry has posted a 17.8% gain over the past six months, beating the S&P 500 by 6.7 percentage points.
